recentItems.title: Yamagola Malli Modalaindi Telugu Full Length Movie | Srikanth, Venu, Reemasen | Shalimar Cinema
recentItems.description:
Yamagola Malli Modalaindi is a hilarious Telugu socio-fantasy comedy starring Srikanth, Meera Jasmine, Venu and Reema Sen in the lead roles.

The story revolves around Yama and Chitragupta, who decide to retire from their duties and send their successors, Junior Yama and Junior Chitragupta, to Earth on an important mission. Their assignment takes an unexpected turn when Junior Yama falls in love with Aishwarya, the very person whose life he has been sent to take. Meanwhile, Junior Chitragupta falls for police officer Vaijayanti.

What follows is a fun-filled combination of comedy, romance, fantasy, Yamaloka episodes and entertaining twists. The film also features veteran actor Kaikala Satyanarayana as Yama, connecting the movie with the classic Yamagola.

⭐ Movie: Yamagola Malli Modalaindi
🎭 Genre: Comedy / Socio-Fantasy
🗣️ Language: Telugu
📅 Release: 23 August 2007
🎬 Director: Srinivasa Reddy
👨‍🎤 Hero: Srikanth
👩‍🎤 Heroine: Meera Jasmine
👨‍🎤 Cast: Venu, Reema Sen, Kaikala Satyanarayana, Krishna Bhagawan, Jayaprakash Reddy, Brahmanandam, Naresh and others
🎵 Music: Jeevan Thomas
📽️ Cinematography: Prasad
